entries.name: Serial terminal and log analyser
entries.desc: Open a saved Meshtastic log to analyse it. For live USB serial, use the download below

entries.name: Download serial terminal (for live USB)
entries.desc: Download one file. Open it from your downloads in Chrome or Edge. Live USB serial works there. The box shows the SHA-256 hash of the file next to it. The hash shows that the file is not damaged. It does not show who published the file
